about: Hand-made mappings for the sky130A gap table (GAPS-sky130A 1.1 and its map_rules.py). Keys are the rule IDs of Magic's why-texts (the SkyWater periphery names). Every other part of the table is generated.

other_check.difftap.2: the foundry's core rule difftap.c1, diffusion width 0.14 µm inside areaid:ce; Magic's diff/tap.2 is the transistor width 0.42 µm (GAPS-sky130A ranked gap 7)
other_check.poly.3: the foundry's core rule poly.c2, poly spacing 0.16 µm; Magic's poly.3 is the poly resistor width 0.33 µm (GAPS-sky130A ranked gap 7)

other_check.varac.4: licon on tap to Var_channel 0.25 µm, the manual's varac.4 and the same check as licon.10; Magic's varac.4 (printed var.4) is the n-tap's extension past the varactor

met3.4.note: Magic measures from its via2 contact area, 0.04 µm past the cut (via2.4), so its 0.025 µm is 0.065 µm from the cut

capm.11.note: sky130A_mr.drc's capm.2b_a keeps met3 that does not touch the capm's bottom plate (capm and met3, grown by 0.14 µm) 1.2 µm from it, which is Magic's 1.34 µm from the capm; its capm.11 is a second check at 0.5 µm

nsd.10b.note: Magic checks the n-tap's area, 0.07011 µm², the area of a square tap whose 0.125 µm implant reaches 0.265 µm²; the manual's rule is the drawn nsdm's area (n/psd.10a, 0.265 µm²), which sky130A.lydrc checks as n/psdm.10a

psd.10b.note: Magic checks the p-tap's area at 0.07011 µm², the same value as its n-tap check; the manual's rule is the drawn psdm's area (n/psd.10b, 0.255 µm²), which sky130A.lydrc checks as n/psdm.10b at 0.265 µm²
